title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Explore the essential corridors and blocks surrounding Bradley University, from the historic Uplands neighborhood to the vibrant West Main Street commercial district.

cards.title: Campustown Shopping Center
cards.subtitle: West Main Street Corridor
cards.notes: Visit this immediate off-campus hub for quick dining at Subway or Pizza Hut and essential services like t-shirt printing and nail salons.
cards.short_summary: A central retail and dining hub located directly across from the Bradley University campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Campustown Shopping Center is located at 1200 West Main Street and features various shops, restaurants, and services adjacent to the university.
cards.access_notes: Open daily for public shopping and dining; hours vary by individual business.

cards.title: Goldin Gateway
cards.subtitle: Main & University Intersection
cards.notes: Walk through the new signature campus entrance featuring elegant landscaping and branding at the corner of Main and University.
cards.short_summary: A newly developed formal entryway connecting the university to the surrounding Peoria community.
cards.evidence_claim: The Goldin Gateway is a new entrance built on the southwest corner of Main and University streets to foster interaction with the urban setting.

cards.title: One World Café
cards.subtitle: West Main Street Corridor
cards.notes: Gather at this local landmark for global-inspired dishes and coffee in a vibrant setting at the edge of the Moss-Bradley neighborhood.
cards.short_summary: A popular student and local dining destination known for its eclectic menu and community atmosphere.
cards.evidence_claim: One World Café is located at 1245 W Main St and is a culinary anchor for the Moss-Bradley and university community.
cards.source_title: Shop Local, Dine Local | Peoria Magazine
cards.access_notes: Open for breakfast, lunch, and dinner; check official site for current daily hours.

cards.title: Laura Bradley Park
cards.subtitle: North Park Road Corridor
cards.notes: Explore 140 acres of trails, picnic sites, and a dog exercise area in this historic park located directly west of campus.
cards.short_summary: A large municipal park offering extensive outdoor recreation space adjacent to the university.
cards.evidence_claim: Bradley Park is a 140-acre park located at 1317 North Park Road, adjacent to Bradley University.
cards.access_notes: Open daily from sunrise to sunset; free public access.

cards.title: St. James Apartments
cards.subtitle: West Main Street Corridor
cards.notes: Walk past this 17-building university-managed community that serves as a primary off-campus housing hub for upperclassmen.
cards.short_summary: A significant off-campus residential district managed by Bradley University for its students.
cards.evidence_claim: St. James Apartments is an off-campus property located at 1103 W. Main Street, consisting of 17 buildings for Bradley students.
cards.access_notes: Residential area; public sidewalks are accessible, but buildings require student credentials.

cards.title: Studios on Sheridan
cards.subtitle: Sheridan Road Corridor
cards.notes: Browse artist studios and unique local shops in the Sunbeam Building, a creative hub just a few blocks from the main campus.
cards.short_summary: An arts and culture center featuring local artist workspaces and retail boutiques.
cards.evidence_claim: Studios on Sheridan is located in the Sunbeam Building and features artist studios, shops, and escape rooms in the West Main neighborhood.
cards.source_title: Shop Local, Dine Local | Peoria Magazine
cards.access_notes: Open to the public; check for First Friday events for extended artist studio access.

cards.title: Lit. on Fire Used Books
cards.subtitle: West Main Street Corridor
cards.notes: Search for gently used titles at this independent bookstore, a staple of the West Main arts and small business district.
cards.short_summary: A local independent bookstore specializing in used books and community literary events.
cards.evidence_claim: Lit. On Fire is a used bookstore located in the West Main neighborhood hub of arts and culture.
cards.source_title: Shop Local, Dine Local | Peoria Magazine
cards.access_notes: Public retail hours; check social media for current schedule.

cards.title: Metro Centre
cards.subtitle: North University Street Corridor
cards.notes: Drive north to find a variety of local shops and the Peoria Farmers Market, located just a few minutes from the campus core.
cards.short_summary: A major retail center on University Street featuring local boutiques and a seasonal farmers market.
cards.evidence_claim: Metro Centre is located at 4700 N. University St. and hosts the Peoria Farmers Market.
cards.access_notes: Public shopping center; Farmers Market typically runs May through October.

cards.title: Moon Dancer Boutique
cards.subtitle: West Main Street Corridor
cards.notes: Shop for funky clothing and unique accessories at this long-standing boutique in the West Main urban hub.
cards.short_summary: An eclectic boutique offering unique fashion and gifts near the Bradley campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Moon Dancer is described as a shop for funky clothing and accessories in Peoria's West Main neighborhood.
cards.source_title: The shop that keeps things spiritual - The Bradley Scout
cards.access_notes: Standard retail hours; open to the public.

cards.title: Moss Avenue
cards.subtitle: Moss-Bradley Historic District
cards.notes: Stroll down this historic tree-lined street to view classic brick homes and architecture in the neighborhood south of campus.
cards.short_summary: A scenic historic corridor known for its grand architecture and proximity to the university.
cards.evidence_claim: Moss Avenue is a central feature of the Moss-Bradley neighborhood, known for its tree-lined streets and historic homes.
cards.source_title: A Foodie's Guide to Moss-Bradley - HelloNation
cards.access_notes: Public residential street; accessible 24/7 for walking and driving.
